title: Namaz e Mayyat
introduction:
NAMAZ E MAYYAT

The following is quoted, yet briefly, from the book entitled Zad al-Ma’ad by ‘Allamah al-Majlisi, may Allah show him mercy, under the title: Chapter: the Deceased Prayer:

The performance of the ritual Deceased Prayer is obligatory upon every Muslim individual who knows about the death of somebody. If one Muslim performs this prayer, the other Muslims will be exempted from this obligatory duty. Unanimously agreed by all scholars, the Deceased Prayer is obligatory upon all mature Twelver Shi’ites. However, it is most famous and most acceptable that this prayer is obligatory upon even the immature who are more than six year old. Apparently, it is sufficiently acceptable to intend seeking nearness to Almighty Allah (rather than pronouncing the words of intention). To perform the Deceased Prayer for the dead bodies of the less than six month year old babies who have been born alive is deemed highly recommended by some scholars, but deemed heretic by some others. However, it is precautious to neglect performing this prayer for these babies.

According to the religious law, the foremost people to perform the Deceased Prayer are the nearest to the deceased people and who deserve the largest quantity of his/her inheritance. This is the most familiar law. Thus, a husband must precede others in performing the Deceased Prayer of his wife.

The performer of the Deceased Prayer must face the kiblah direction and stand to the right side of the head of the dead body, which must be laid down on the back.

Validity of the Deceased Prayer is not conditional upon ceremonial purity; therefore, it is valid for the ceremonially impure, the menstruating women, and those who have not performed the ritual ablution (wuzu’) to perform such prayers, although it is recommended for the performers of this prayer to have performed the ritual ablution. If water is not available, there is something prevents from using water, or there is not enough time to perform the ritual ablution, it is then highly recommended, according to traditions, to perform the dry ablution (i.e. tayammum). However, it is understood from the apparent meanings of some traditions that dry ablution should be used even if there is nothing prevents from performing the ritual ablution.

It is also traditional that the performer of the Deceased Prayer should stand in the middle of the dead body of a man and in front of the breast of the dead body of a woman. This is the most familiar rule. Besides, the performer of the Deceased Prayer should take off the shoes and must intend performing the Deceased Prayer. He must then repeat the takbir statement five times. It is also traditional that he raises his hands to the level of his ears while uttering these statements. verses.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ
verses.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah

verses.arabic: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُوْلُ اللهِ۔
verses.translation: and I bear witness that Muhammad is Allah’s messenger.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
O Allah, (please) forgive the believing men and women.
O Allah, (please) forgive this dead person.
(1) Allah is the Most Great.
I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,
One and Only and having no associate,

verses.arabic: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُوْلُهُ
verses.translation: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger;
He has sent him with the truth as conveyor of good tidiness and warner (against His chastisement)
before the coming of the Hour (of Resurrection).
(2) Allah is the Most Great.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

verses.arabic: وَّ بَارِكْ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: send benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and show mercy to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

verses.arabic: كَاَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ وَ بَارَكْتَ وَ تَرَحَّمْتَ
verses.translation: in the most favorable way You have sent blessings, benedictions, and mercy
to Abraham and the Household of Abraham.
Verily, You are praiseworthy and All-glorious.

verses.arabic: وَ صَلِّ عَلٰى جَمِيْعِ الْاَنْبِيَاۤءِ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: And (please) send blessings upon all the prophets and messengers.
(3) Allah is the Most Great.
O Allah, (please) forgive the believing men and women
and the Muslim men and women,
both the alive and the dead.
(Please) combine between them and ns in bliss and happiness.
Verily, You are the responding to the prayers.
Verily, You have power over all things.
(4) Allah is the Most Great.
O Allah, this is Your servant
and the son of Your servant and Your she-servant;
he is now Your guest
and You are the ever best of all those who receive guests.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا لَا نَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ اِلَّا خَيْرًا
verses.translation: O Allah, we know about him nothing but goodness
while You know about him better than we do.
O Allah, if he is good-doer,
then (pleas) grant him more good turns from You,
and if he is wrongdoer,
then (please) excuse and forgive him.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ عِنْدَكَ فِىْ اَعْلٰی عِلِّيِّيْنَ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) place him with You in the highest point of the Highest Position,
make those of his family members who remained behind him to take his place,
and have mercy on him with Your mercy.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah, this is Your she-servant
and the daughter of Your servant and Your she-servant;
she is now Your guest
and You are the ever best of all those who receive guests.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّا لَا نَعْلَمُ مِنْهَا اِلَّا خَيْرًا
verses.translation: O Allah, we know about her nothing but goodness
while You know about her better than we do.
O Allah, if she is good-doer,
then (please) grant her more good turns from You,
and if she is wrongdoer,
then (please) excuse and forgive her.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْهَا عِنْدَكَ فِىْ اَعْلٰی عِلِّيِّيْنَ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) place her with You in the highest point of the Highest Position,
make those of her family members who remained behind her to take her place,
and have mercy on her with Your mercy.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah, (please) forgive those who have repented
and followed Your Path
and protect them against the chastisement of Hellfire.
O Allah, (please) make for his parents and for us
a progeny,a precedence, and a reward.
